[Section] APPENDIX ::: Systems and their descriptions: ::: System description for UNCC_QA3:
[source_id=137] System is finetuned on the SQuAD 2.0 [reference] and BioASQ dataset[].For data preprocessing Context / paragraph is generated from relevant snippets provided in the test data.
[source_id=138] Fine tuning process is same as it is done for the system ‘UNCC_QA_1’ in test batch-5. Difference is during data preprocessing, Context/paragraph is generated form from the relevant documents for which URLS are included in the test data.
